extra.message: DOM-based XSS: the URL fragment (attacker-controlled document.location.hash) is decoded with decodeURIComponent() in createInnerHTML() (line 27) and rendered directly to the DOM via dangerouslySetInnerHTML on this element (line 54). An attacker can craft a URL such as /browser-vulnerabilities/dom-xss# (or use the on-page 'Exploit me!' link, whose dangerousLinkTo() sets the hash to the SAMPLE_ATTACK payload on line 6) and script executes in the victim's browser. The hash-derived value is never sanitized before being assigned to innerHTML.
